meta.description: Buy, sell, lease and invest in UAE property with GTG Real Estate. Residential, commercial, off-plan and Golden Visa property guidance.

hero.title: Private real estate advisory across the UAE.
hero.body: Whether you want to invest, buy, sell, lease or manage property, our team is ready to assist you personally and professionally.
hero.photoAlt: Nabeel Al Naghi, founder of GTG Real Estate, in the GTG office

services.title: How We Serve Our Clients
services.approachBody: Listen first. Understand the objective. Present the right options. Negotiate carefully. Stay involved until completion.

items.title: Residential & Luxury Property
items.body: Advisory for homes, apartments, villas and selected lifestyle assets, whether for end use or investment.

items.title: Commercial Real Estate
items.body: Support for offices, retail, commercial units, buildings and income-generating property opportunities.

items.title: Plots & Development Opportunities
items.body: Guidance on residential and commercial plots, development land and investor-focused opportunities.

items.title: Buying, Selling & Investment Advisory
items.body: Market-led support through acquisitions, disposals, negotiations, pricing and investment decision-making.

items.title: Off-Plan & Secondary Market
items.body: Access to selected developer launches as well as ready and resale opportunities across the UAE.

items.title: Property Management & Leasing Support
items.body: Assistance for owners who want their properties positioned, leased and managed with professional follow-through.

items.title: Golden Visa Property Guidance
items.body: Support for eligible property investors navigating the real-estate related Golden Visa process with the relevant specialists.
